help:
usage: gnd solve [-h] --workspace WORKSPACE [--experiment EXPERIMENT]
                 [--from FROM_STATION] [--until UNTIL] [--skip NAME] [--auto]
                 [--adapter {claude,codex}] [--adapter-policy ADAPTER_POLICY]
                 [--test-argv WORD] [--station-timeout NAME=SECONDS]
                 model

Walk the CLI-pure GND stations in locked order -- validate, synth, codegen, exp-run, conformance -- blocking for an authorization before each one and appending an authorization record to a walk log before the station is spawned.

WHAT THIS GUARANTEES: sequence, gating and logging FOR WALKS THAT GO THROUGH IT. Nothing more.

WHAT IT DOES NOT GUARANTEE: the process in general. Running the stations a la carte stays legal and is not a violation of anything -- a harness that could not be bypassed would be routed around, and a bypassed harness is worse than none, because its log's existence would falsely imply the walk is where work happens.

IT DOES NOT JUDGE STATION-INTERNAL AGENT WORK. The guarantee's perimeter is the walk log's perimeter.

A STATION'S OWN EXIT IS IN THE LOG, NOT IN THIS COMMAND'S EXIT CODE. The exit code is a control plane: 0 a completed walk or informational action, 17 a walk that halted at a station, 64 usage, 66 a missing path, 70 an internal defect, 74 an I/O refusal. A caller scripting this command reads the code and then reads the log; a station exiting 11 does not make gnd solve claim a collision about itself.

THE BROWNFIELD PROFILE ASSUMES RECOVERY ALREADY COMPLETED. --skip synth --skip codegen --skip conformance leaves gnd validate; a recovered model's gate is gnd recovery verify, which runs BEFORE this harness is entered, not inside it.

THE WALK LOG RECORDS WHAT THIS HARNESS DID; IT IS NOT PROOF THAT IT DID IT. A log that satisfies the walk predicate is a self-consistent document, and a file authored by hand can be self-consistent too. It attests no spawn, no executed argv, no existing artifact and no human presence.

THE OUTER STATION TIMEOUT IS NOT THE CONTRACT'S INNER --wall-seconds BOUND. --station-timeout bounds the child process; this harness passes no --wall-seconds to gnd exp run, because a contract's own wall bound is the contract's business.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        the directory every station writes into. Required: a
                        walk that wrote five artifacts into whatever directory
                        the caller happened to be standing in is the accident
                        this argument exists to prevent
  --experiment EXPERIMENT
                        the data-driven experiment directory for the exp-run
                        station, which must resolve strictly inside
                        --workspace. Mandatory when exp-run is selected and
                        refused when it is not
  --from FROM_STATION   first station to run, inclusive
  --until UNTIL         last station to run, inclusive
  --skip NAME           omit a station; repeatable, and repeating one name is
                        not an error
  --auto                authorize every gate without blocking. The log is NOT
                        byte-identical to a gated walk: flags.auto is true and
                        every authorization carries the auto source token
  --adapter {claude,codex}
                        terminal-agent adapter for the exp-run station;
                        resolves to claude
  --adapter-policy ADAPTER_POLICY
                        trusted local declared-adapter policy for a schema-v6
                        exp-run station
  --test-argv WORD      forwarded to the exp-run station verbatim, in the
                        order given
  --station-timeout NAME=SECONDS
                        override one station's outer timeout. SECONDS is a
                        positive integer no greater than 86400: an unbounded
                        override is an unbounded child wearing a flag
